notes: The pie now fans, and the sliders live on the rim — rebuilt from Michael's Sensu reference. On open, the slices start bunched toward the handle and rotate open into place with a spring settle; you can slide onto a slice while it blooms. Brightness and volume are now one band around the outer rim, meeting at the crown — ride the rim to scrub, with a full arc sweep covering about the full range. Everything else (tap to park, edge claim, centre readout) carries over.
